answered.question: Which term is missing from the pack's printed decomposition? (opened 2026-09-12)
answered.answer: The regression intercept, fit.coefficients[0], at engines/attribution/decompose.py:197. It enters `expected` and is therefore subtracted out of the idiosyncratic residual, but it is not one of the five entries in `contribs`, so it is never printed.
answered.proof: Synthetic series with a known drift of +0.200%/session: fitted alpha +0.00213; return minus the sum of all five printed components +0.00213. Identical to five decimals.
notes: Not the proxy's fault: the same gaps, to within 0.03pp, were present against the ETF when the market leg was +0.00%.
Genting's -0.24pp is twice its entire printed idiosyncratic component.
Still open: should alpha be printed as a sixth component, or reported as drift with a warning when it exceeds the idiosyncratic term?

answered.question: Should the decomposition refuse when the proxy's session volume is below a floor? (opened 2026-09-12)
answered.answer: SUPERSEDED. The proxy is an index now and has no share volume to be thin. No volume floor would have helped: the ETF's problem on the other 1,067 sessions was not stale prints but that nothing covaried with it. A liquidity floor catches the bad day; only an R-squared check catches the bad instrument.

lessons: A proxy is validated by the betas it produces, not by whether it returns data. The ETF returned a close on 1,067 of 1,231 sessions and gave a bank a beta of 0.12; the failure was visible in every fit for three years and nothing was looking at the fits.
When a fix lands, measure the same names both ways before writing about it. 'The proxy is better' is a claim; a beta table with the old column beside the new one is a finding, and it cost one script.

An unexplained share that survives a change of instrument is a measurement; one that does not was arithmetic. Petronas Chemicals held 98% and IHH fell from 100% to 72% - only one of those was ever about the company.
A residual labelled 'idiosyncratic' will absorb any term the printer forgets, silently and with a plausible name. The gap was visible for two pages before anyone read the line that produced it.

Waiting is an action and it needs its own evidence. sweep --due named a slot as owed and the correct response was to do nothing, because the delay distribution - not the cron - says when a run is missing.
